```yaml
name: Codex/docs only speech hygiene clean

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    types: [ opened, synchronize, reopened ]

jobs:
  codex-clean:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        with:
          separator: ","
          files: |
            **/*.py
            **/*.md
            **/*.rst
            **/*.txt
            **/*.yml
            **/*.yaml

      - name: Run Codex speech hygiene clean
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files_count > 0
        uses: openai/codex-action@v1
        with:
          prompt: |
            Clean up the following files for speech hygiene and documentation quality:
            - Remove redundant or unnecessary comments
            - Ensure consistent docstring formatting
            - Improve clarity and flow of explanations
            - Remove any outdated or irrelevant information
            - Maintain technical accuracy while improving readability
            
            Files to process:
            ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}
            
            Focus specifically on:
            1. Documentation files (README, docs, etc.)
            2. Code comments and docstrings
            3. Any natural language text in code
            4. Ensure consistency in terminology and style
            
            Return only the cleaned content without any additional explanation.
          openai-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          model: gpt-4
          effort: high
          working-directory: .

      - name: Commit cleaned files
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files_count > 0
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "docs: Codex speech hygiene clean" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.head_ref }} || echo "Push failed, likely no changes"

  docs-only-check:
    needs: codex-clean
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for documentation-only changes
        id: docs-check
        run: |
          # Check if only documentation files have changed
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
          DOC_ONLY=true
          
          for file in $CHANGED_FILES; do
            if [[ ! "$file" =~ \.(md|rst|txt|yml|yaml)$ ]]; then
              DOC_ONLY=false
              break
            fi
          done
          
          echo "doc_only_changes=$DOC_ONLY" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Changed files: $CHANGED_FILES"

      - name: Skip backend tests for docs-only changes
        if: env.doc_only_changes == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Only documentation changes detected. Skipping backend tests."
          exit 0
```
